recommendation: Keep this source fix. It is a narrow current-build correction for the original priority-perspective clarification after later approved Goal.acceptance changes; no further core source work is indicated for FHIR-7087.
issue_request: FHIR-7087 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for Goal. It asked whether Goal.priority is the patient's priority or the practitioner's priority, and the accepted resolution was to define Goal.priority as the mutually agreed priority, note ordinal extension support for numeric weighting, and add an acceptance mechanism with individual, status, and priority details.
initial_application: SVN #6806, represented in git by 8bd3bd917d537625fad908b5f0f6277d113b941e, changed Goal.priority to the mutually agreed definition, added the per-participant priority comment and ordinal-extension note, and added the original goal-acceptance extension/value set material.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-44978 elevated the goal-acceptance extension into the base Goal resource, and the FHIR Extension Pack goal-acceptance definition now limits version-specific use through FHIR 5.0 and states that the extension was elevated to base Goal in R6. FHIR-28217 refined Goal.acceptance participant wording and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-56542 later changed Goal.acceptance.priority to the THO goal-priority value set.
reconciliation: Changed source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml so Goal.priority directs current implementers to Goal.acceptance.priority for participant-specific priorities, while preserving the mutually agreed priority definition and ordinal-extension numeric ranking note.
source_changes: source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml: updated the Goal.priority comment from a generic extension recommendation to the current Goal.acceptance.priority mechanism.
